in_sanskrit.name: Biltu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Wind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Biltu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Biltu is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Vayu', which means 'God of Wind'. In Hindu mythology, Vayu is one of the eight primary gods and is responsible for the movement of air. The name Biltu is believed to bring the qualities of strength, adaptability, and a connection to the natural world.
